episodes.synopsis: After winning a contest, twins Shugo and Rena enter The World as legendary hacker characters. Shugo is defeated by an unexpectedly powerful monster, which leads to his resurrection by a mysterious woman.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero

episodes.synopsis: Balmung decides to throw an event to make cherry blossom trees bloom, which Shugo, Rena, and their new sidekick Mireille decide to attend. After a monster appears, Shugo must rely on a furry friend for help in battle.
episodes.title: Kite’s Bracelet

episodes.synopsis: Shugo levels up by letting the members in his party do all the work. Next, he helps another player whose sick grunty can only be cured with an item located in a dangerous part of The World.
episodes.title: The Phoenix Feather

episodes.synopsis: Sanjuro begins to train Shugo, and Rena is selected as the damsel in distress in an event that can make wishes come true.
episodes.title: Tanabata Night

episodes.synopsis: Rena falls into a trap that was intended for Shugo. Her disappearance leaves the group wondering where she’s gone.
episodes.title: Mansion of Terror

episodes.synopsis: The search for Rena begins. A mysterious message leads the search party to a dangerous location. The party is caught off guard by heartbreaking news.
episodes.title: Trap of the Hot Steaming Water

episodes.synopsis: Rena remains in a comatose state and is unable to log out of The World. Balmung reveals that several other users have been affected in a similar way.
episodes.title: Twilight Moon

episodes.synopsis: Balmung has his role as an administrator taken away, and Rena attempts to contact Shugo with the help of Aura.
episodes.title: The Solitary Knight

episodes.synopsis: Shugo uses a new ability to try and reach Rena. The two are almost united, but a rogue AI complicates the situation.
episodes.title: Footsteps of Collapse

episodes.synopsis: Shugo continues his training with the group, and their teamwork is tested by the appearance of a new monster.
episodes.title: Capital of Illusion

episodes.synopsis: After fending off a dangerous wave of attacks, the group learns of Aura’s plan to maintain the balance of The World through the use of unconventional methods.
episodes.title: The End of the World

episodes.synopsis: A virus prevents the party from achieving victory in battle. With data drain left as the only option, Shugo must use his abilities like never before to save Rena.
episodes.title: The Legend Begins
